crossRefs.note: He found a certain Jew named Aquila, a man of Pontus by race, who had recently come from Italy, with his wife…
He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside, and explained…
The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you much in the Lord, together with the assembly that is…
Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.
Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.
that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.
